# npm `node-forge` — OSS Knowledge Base Package Page Outline

---

## Package Metadata

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Registry** | npm |
| **Package** | `node-forge` |
| **Latest version** | 1.4.0 |
| **Weekly downloads** | ~33.5 M (2026-05-06 – 2026-05-12) |
| **Repository** | https://github.com/digitalbazaar/forge |
| **Archived** | No |
| **Last repo push** | 2026-03-25 |

---

## Security Posture Notes

- **Extremely high adoption** (~33.5 M weekly downloads), making any unpatched vulnerability high-impact across the ecosystem.
- **Active maintenance signal**: repo pushed as recently as March 2025; security fixes shipped promptly in 1.3.0, 1.3.2, and 1.4.0.
- **Recurring vulnerability themes**: The library has a persistent pattern of (1) **RSA / Ed25519 signature verification bypasses** (Bleichenbacher-style forgeries, malleability) and (2) **ASN.1 parser weaknesses** (recursion DoS, validator desync, OID truncation). Consumers using node-forge for any signature-verification or certificate-chain-validation path should treat upgrade to **≥ 1.4.0** as mandatory.
- **Legacy API surface removed**: Prototype-pollution and URL-parsing issues existed in deprecated utility APIs (`forge.debug`, `forge.util.setPath`, `forge.util.parseUrl`) that were fully removed by 1.0.0.
- **All known advisories are fixed** in the current latest (1.4.0). No outstanding unpatched issues at time of writing.

---

## Vulnerability Table

Advisories are grouped where they share the same root cause or fix version.

### Group 1 — RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 Signature Forgery (Bleichenbacher-class)

| GHSA ID | CVE | Severity | Fixed In | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GHSA-cfm4-qjh2-4765 | CVE-2022-24771 | **HIGH** | 1.3.0 | RSA sig verification lenient on DigestInfo structure; allows padding-steal forgery with low-e keys. |
| GHSA-x4jg-mjrx-434g | CVE-2022-24772 | **HIGH** | 1.3.0 | RSA sig verification doesn't reject trailing garbage after DigestInfo; enables forgery with low-e keys. |
| GHSA-2r2c-g63r-vccr | CVE-2022-24773 | **MODERATE** | 1.3.0 | RSA sig verification doesn't fully validate DigestInfo ASN.1 structure; accepts invalid-but-digest-matching sigs. |
| GHSA-ppp5-5v6c-4jwp | CVE-2026-33894 | **HIGH** | 1.4.0 | Regression / variant of CVE-2022-24771: extra ASN.1 field within structure + missing 8-byte padding check per RFC 2313 §8 still permits Bleichenbacher-style forgery. |

**Common root cause:** Incomplete strictness in PKCS#1 v1.5 decoding — multiple rounds of hardening were required (1.3.0, then 1.4.0).

---

### Group 2 — ASN.1 Parser Weaknesses

| GHSA ID | CVE | Severity | Fixed In | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GHSA-554w-wpv2-vw27 | CVE-2025-66031 | **HIGH** | 1.3.2 | Unbounded recursion in `asn1.fromDer`; crafted deep DER blob causes stack-exhaustion DoS. |
| GHSA-5gfm-wpxj-wjgq | CVE-2025-12816 | **HIGH** | 1.3.2 | Interpretation conflict in `asn1.validate`; schema desynchronization can bypass downstream crypto verifications. |
| GHSA-65ch-62r8-g69g | CVE-2025-66030 | **MODERATE** | 1.3.2 | 32-bit bitwise truncation in `asn1.derToOid` causes oversized OID arcs to decode as trusted shorter OIDs. |

**Common root cause:** The pure-JS ASN.1 parser lacked depth limits, strict tag matching, and safe integer handling. All three fixed in 1.3.2.

---

### Group 3 — Ed25519 Signature Malleability

| GHSA ID | CVE | Severity | Fixed In | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GHSA-q67f-28xg-22rw | CVE-2026-33895 | **HIGH** | 1.4.0 | Ed25519 verification missing `S ≥ L` (group order) check per RFC 8032 §8.4; non-canonical signatures accepted, enabling signature-uniqueness bypasses. |

---

### Group 4 — X.509 Certificate Chain Verification Bypass

| GHSA ID | CVE | Severity | Fixed In | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GHSA-2328-f5f3-gj25 | CVE-2026-33896 | **HIGH** | 1.4.0 | `pki.verifyCertificateChain()` skips basicConstraints & keyUsage enforcement when extensions are absent; a leaf cert can impersonate a CA. |

---

### Group 5 — Denial of Service via BigInteger

| GHSA ID | CVE | Severity | Fixed In | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GHSA-5m6q-g25r-mvwx | CVE-2026-33891 | **HIGH** | 1.4.0 | `BigInteger.modInverse(0)` (bundled jsbn) enters infinite loop → 100 % CPU hang. |

---

| GHSA ID | CVE | Severity | Fixed In | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
